comparison.objective: Free a cable pinned under stacked cases without moving them; candidate screens media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Load stabilization and constrained cable extraction versus pouring and bridge-clearing agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Cord freed and plug binned without case displacement versus ≥98% media recovered with all washers retained.
comparison.reason: Both require avoiding disturbance, but the actual manipulation and end state differ materially.
